response.sql: WITH purpose_avg AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM purpose_avg) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM purpose_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC;

assumptions.assumption: The blank purpose code is stored as an empty string '' in k_symbol. The schema makes k_symbol NOT NULL, so no NULLs exist, and GROUP BY keeps '' as its own group. Whitespace-only values are not treated as blank here.

'Standing orders' means the rows of the `order` table, as the request states. The threshold is strict (amount > 2802), and the simple average is taken over the purpose groups that remain after that filter.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat any whitespace-only k_symbol as blank too, so such rows join the blank-code group rather than forming their own group.
alternatives.sql: WITH purpose_avg AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(k_symbol), ''), '') AS k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(k_symbol), ''), '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM purpose_avg) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM purpose_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC;
